title: quiz_structure
description: One row per question in a quiz: the question bank / answer key. Source table data/tables/quiz_structure.csv. Composite key (quiz_id, question_number). Joins to details.csv on (quiz_id, question_number) to grade answers.

quiz_id.description: Quiz this question belongs to. Foreign key to quiz_meta.quiz_id.

language.description: ISO 639-2/B three-letter language code of the quiz.

question_number.description: 1-based position of this question within the quiz.

correct_answer.description: The correct option; must be one of the values in `options`.

num_options.description: Number of answer options offered (count of entries in `options`).

options.description: The answer options as a single ' | '-delimited string (pipe surrounded by spaces), e.g. 'A | B | C | D'. Split on ' | ' to recover the individual options; the count equals num_options.
